patch_summary: v637 plus a bounded Q/K bet: force only the QKS smoothing acceptance. q <- q*s, k <- k/s is exactly logits-preserving ((q*s).(k/s) = q.k), so it cannot corrupt the logits - it only redistributes quantization difficulty. Official sample 0.154586 -> 0.247073 and online_profiled_v2 0.610325 -> 0.631833, both up, with the gq and refinement guards left honest.
